latest_release.body:
# DeskBox 1.6.0

The custom widget ecosystem, clipboard workflow, and companion-process architecture release. DeskBox 1.6.0 introduces a zero-WebView native WinUI 3 Custom Widget engine paired with an air-gapped QuickJS script sandbox (`logic.js`), Widget Studio with three AI/Agent creation channels and 14 localized official templates across 13 languages, a full-featured Clipboard History widget with a global `Alt+V` Quick Paste popup and offline image OCR, a unified Global Search popup (`Alt+D`) with calculator/commands/app folders (retiring the standalone Search widget), universal tabbed widget groups with acrylic merge/detach previews, a reworked Desktop Organization workbench, major Todo/QuickCapture/Music/Glance upgrades, and isolated companion host processes (`--settings` / `--studio`) that keep the resident desktop host lean.

Release date: 2026-11-23.

## Highlights

- **Declarative Custom Widgets, QuickJS Sandbox & Widget Studio.** Render native WinUI 3 desktop widgets from a declarative `manifest.json` element graph with zero WebView memory overhead, backed by an air-gapped QuickJS (`logic.js`) sandbox with strict instruction, wall-clock, and memory quotas plus per-widget capability gates (Internet, LAN/localhost, clipboard/system, local files, command execution). Author or customize widgets via Direct API (BYOK), External Coding Agents (`--mcp` stdio bridge & CLI skills with mandatory native host approval and stage-and-preview confirmation), or zero-setup Web AI prompt handoff. Ships with 14 official templates localized into all 13 languages — including System Monitor (CPU, RAM, GPU, VRAM, Top Processes, Drives, plus an integrated Recycle Bin drop target and Search launcher), AI Usage Monitor, Pomodoro & Sedentary Posture Guardian, Statutory Holiday & Payday Countdown, World Clock with a 24-hour meeting scrubber, Ambient Focus noise mixer, Dev Toolbox, Quick Actions Hub, Weather Desk, and Todo Agenda — alongside ECDSA P-256 signed remote catalog/prompt updates, `.dbxwidget` packages, and `deskbox://` deep links.
- **Clipboard History, Global Quick Paste (`Alt+V`) & Offline Image OCR.** Capture text, HTML/RTF, images, files, and color swatches with instant search, a keyboard-first `Alt+V` Quick Paste popup that pastes straight back into the active window, on-device offline OCR text indexing, built-in text transforms, optional webpage URL title fetching (off by default, skipping one-time auth and internal links), pinning, and per-app exclusions. Uses keyed HMAC-SHA256 deduplication, externalized payloads for large entries, local DPAPI encryption and UI masking for secrets, and optional decrypted portable export for cross-PC migration.
- **Unified Global Search (`Alt+D`) & Search Widget Retirement.** Adds an instant calculator, quick command palette, one-keystroke web fallback, and Recommendation Edit Mode with custom app folders, multi-select drag-to-reorder, and batch hide/unhide, smoothly retiring the standalone desktop Search widget.
- **Universal Widget Groups, Desktop Organization Workbench & Window Layering.** Any widget types can join tabbed groups with connected Windows 11 tabs or equal-width tabs, overflow scroll arrows, `Ctrl+Wheel` pan, spring-animated reorder, native acrylic merge/detach placement previews, and reliable inactive-tab detaching and merge-undo. Desktop Organization gains a dedicated preview-and-routing workbench with per-widget rules, background filing, and history review, alongside desktop-pinned bottom layering vs normal window layering.
- **Todo, QuickCapture, Music & Glance Upgrades.** Todo adds natural-language date/time/recurrence input (English & Chinese), full-text search, an overdue reschedule bar with undo, batch checklist paste, bidirectional Todo ↔ QuickCapture conversion, and task export; QuickCapture adds a popout pinned note window, multi-note merge with undo, IME-safe inline shortcuts, Markdown list continuation, and folder mirror sync; Music adds real-time audio s

# DeskBox **An open-source, local-first Windows 10/11 desktop organizer with native-feeling WinUI 3 widgets and a declarative custom widget ecosystem.** English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [Download](#download) · [Features](#features) · [Visual Experience](#visual-experience) · [Technical Overview](#technical-overview) · [Build from Source](#build-from-source) · [Licensing](LICENSING.md) [![CI](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Tianyu199509/DeskBox?label=release&color=2563EB)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases/latest) [![Windows 10/11](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-10%2F11-0078D4.svg)](#technical-overview) [![x64 and ARM64](https://img.shields.io/badge/architecture-x64%20%7C%20ARM64-5C2D91.svg)](#download) [![License: GPL v3 | Commercial](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPLv3%20%7C%20Commercial-blue.svg)](LICENSING.md) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Tianyu199509/DeskBox?style=flat&color=yellow)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/stargazers) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/total?style=flat&color=brightgreen)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases)
> **Contribution status:** External pull requests are temporarily paused while core architecture and extensibility boundaries settle. Bug reports, feature ideas, and technical discussions are warmly welcomed via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/issues) and Discussions — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ![DeskBox Windows desktop organizer with file, todo, clipboard, weather, music, and custom widgets](docs/images/brand/readme-hero-1-3-7-dark-en.png) Built on C#, WinUI 3, .NET 10 Native AOT, and a Rust native Shell layer, DeskBox adds a lightweight widget layer over the Windows desktop without replacing Explorer or moving your files into a proprietary database. Real-folder-backed file widgets make it a modern open-source alternative to tools such as Stardock Fences, complemented by clipboard history, a global search popup, todos, quick notes, Glance, weather, media controls, and programmable custom desktop widgets. --- ## Download | Channel | Package & Highlights | Link | | --- | --- | --- | | **GitHub Releases (Direct)** | Offline `x64` & `ARM64` Full Native AOT installers bundling a private Windows App Runtime 2.7, silent in-app updates, and companion-process UI isolation | [Latest GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases/latest) | | **Official Website** | Product overview, direct installer downloads, and documentation | [deskbox.fun](https://deskbox.fun) | | **Microsoft Store** | Store-signed MSIX package with Store updates — ideal for supporting ongoing maintenance | [Get it from Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/store/detail/9PBZSNB4D69H) | - **Integrity verification**: Every GitHub Release installer ships alongside a matching `.sha256` sidecar file so you can verify package integrity before running Setup; see the [code signing and verification policy](docs/code-signing.md). - **System requirements**: **Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or later** and **Windows 11 (22H2+ recommended)** on `x64` or native `ARM64` PCs. Supports standard `Program Files` or unelevated per-user installation and works fully offline. - **Release history**: See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for the complete version-by-version history. --- ## Features ### 1. File Widgets & Desktop Organization - **Real-folder storage & mapping**: Create managed storage widgets backed by ordinary folders, or map existing desktop and disk folders in place without moving them. Migrating files into managed storage uses a copy-first, verify-before-commit workflow that never auto-deletes source files. - **Windows 11-native file interactions**: Single-column right-click menus with inline icons, Explorer-ordered items, real "Open with" app associations (including UWP), blank-area "New / View / Sort by" submenus, native ZIP compress/extract, and Spacebar [QuickLook](https://github.com/QL-Win/QuickLook) preview. - **Multi-source drag-and-drop & stacks**: Drag files and links seamlessly to and from Explorer, WeChat, and browsers (including downloading remote URLs), reorder tiles manually, expand nested folder stacks inside widgets or Adaptive / 3×3 / 5×5 popovers, and drag files out safely even from elevated sessions. - **Widget groups & Desktop Organization workbench**: Combine any desktop widgets into tabbed groups (connected tabs or equal-width tabs with `Ctrl+Tab`, wheel switching, and acrylic merge/detach previews); preview rule-based routing before moving desktop files, enable automatic background filing for newly settled items, and review or undo organization history. ### 2. Everyday Productivity & Desktop Widgets - **Unified Global Search popup (`Alt+D`)**: Connects over local IPC to an existing Everything installation (not bundled) and merges file results with DeskBox notes, todos, clipboard history, apps, and settings in one window — featuring an instant calculator, command palette, one-keystroke web fallback, and Recommendation Edit Mode (app folders & multi-select drag-to-reorder). - **Clipboard History & Quick Paste (`Alt+V`)**: Captures text, HTML/RTF, images, files, and color swatches with instant search, a keyboard-first `Alt+V` Quick Paste popup, offline image OCR text indexing, built-in text transforms, optional webpage URL title fetching, per-app exclusions, externalized large entries, and automatic local DPAPI encryption and UI masking for sensitive secrets. - **Responsive Todo & Quick Capture**: Adaptive single- and dual-pane layouts, natural-language date/time/recurrence input, full-text search, overdue reschedule bar, bidirectional Todo ↔ QuickCapture conversion, task reminders, color markers, a popout pinned note window, multi-note merge, and live Markdown folder mirroring with linked or managed attachments. - **Glance, Weather & Music**: Glance displays date, weekday, lunar calendar, solar terms, and custom rotating backgrounds; Weather pairs MSN Weather with Open-Meteo fallback across four bundled icon packs; Music controls Windows media sessions with album-color ambience, audio spectrum visualization, and LRCLIB / local `.lrc` synced lyrics. ### 3. Custom Widgets & Widget Studio - **Zero-WebView declarative engine**: Renders native WinUI 3 desktop widgets from a flat element graph (`manifest.json`) without permanent WebView memory overhead. - **Air-gapped QuickJS script sandbox & permission gates**: Interactive custom widgets run `logic.js` inside an isolated QuickJS sandbox enforced by strict instruction-count, wall-clock, and memory quotas, backed by per-widget capability permissions (Internet, LAN/localhost, clipboard/system, local files, command execution). - **Three authoring channels & Agent integration**: Create or edit widgets via **Direct API (BYOK)**, **External Coding Agents** (`--mcp` stdio bridge & CLI skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, etc.), or **zero-setup Web AI prompt handoff** — alongside 14 localized official templates, ECDSA P-256 signed remote catalog/prompt updates, `.dbxwidget` import/export, `deskbox://` deep links, and mandatory **host approval / stage-and-preview confirmation** before applying external changes. ### 4. Capsule Mode, Native Materials & Multi-Monitor Memory - **Smart capsules & Quick Reveal**: Collapse any widget into a smart capsule or a unified movable capsule bar with hover-to-expand and collapsed text masking. Summon widgets via the tray, `F7`, double `Ctrl`, `Alt+Space`, desktop double-click, or custom global hotkeys. - **Native Windows styling**: Choose Mica or Acrylic materials, DWM rounded corners, custom per-widget icons and backgrounds, and material-matched, unified, or desktop-panorama global backgrounds. - **Hardware-aware multi-monitor memory**: Remembers per-display-topology arrangements bound to monitor hardware identities — unplugging a screen gracefully collapses or relocates its widgets and restores every position upon reconnect, immune to DPI scaling changes, sleep, or full-screen games. ### 5. Lightweight Native AOT Runtime, Backup & Reliability - **Isolated companion processes & low footprint**: Powered by `.NET 10 Full Native AOT` and a Rust native Shell layer. Settings and Widget Studio run in isolated companion host processes over authenticated named-pipe IPC and Shell thumbnails run out-of-process, reclaiming UI memory as soon as windows close alongside tiered idle working-set trimming. - **Resilient storage, portable snapshots & cloud backups**: Atomic snapshot writes and automatic wipe-recovery offers protect settings and layouts from corruption, backed by scheduled local snapshots, portable cross-device backup exports (with optional decrypted clipboard snapshots and automatic credential stripping on untrusted restores), domain-scoped personal WebDAV cloud backups, and one-click privacy-filtered diagnostic bundles. --- ## Visual Experience DeskBox adopts Windows 11 native materials and rounded geometry so widgets blend naturally into your desktop while keeping Explorer workflows intact. | Mica | Acrylic | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox desktop widgets with Mica material in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/云母材质.png) | ![DeskBox desktop widgets with Acrylic material in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/亚克力材质.png) | | Widget Studio — Official Templates & Channels | Widget Studio — Live Stage & AI Co-Creation | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox Widget Studio template gallery in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/studio-gallery.png) | ![DeskBox Widget Studio live stage preview and AI co-creation in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/studio-stage.png) |
Expand Settings screenshots (General / Appearance / Windows & Interaction / Files & Organization / Feature Widgets / Custom Widgets / Global Search / Data & Backup) | General | Appearance | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox General settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/settings-general.png) | ![DeskBox Appearance settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/settings-appearance.png) | | Windows & interaction | Files & organization | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox Windows and interaction settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/settings-interaction.png) | ![DeskBox Files and organization settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/settings-files-organization.png) | | Feature widgets | Custom widgets & Widget Studio | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox Built-in feature widgets settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/settings-feature-widgets.png) | ![DeskBox Custom widgets and Widget Studio settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/settings-custom-widgets.png) | | Global search | Data & backup | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox Global search settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/settings-search.png) | ![DeskBox Data and backup settings in English](docs/images/screenshots/en-us/settings-backup.png) |
--- ## Technical Overview | Item | Details | | --- | --- | | **Supported OS** | Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or later; Windows 11 (22H2+ recommended) | | **Architectures** | `x64` (Intel / AMD) and native `ARM64` (Windows on ARM) | | **Stack** | C#, WinUI 3, .NET 10 Full Native AOT, Windows App SDK 2.7, Rust native Shell layer, QuickJS sandbox | | **Data model** | Local-first; no account or mandatory cloud sync | | **Languages (13)** | English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Bengali, Russian, Korean | | **Licensing** | [GPL-3.0-only](LICENSE) + [Commercial License](LICENSING.md) (dual-licensed) | --- ## Local-First, Privacy & Installation Notes - **Your data stays local**: No account required. Settings and widget data live under `%LocalAppData%\DeskBox\data` on Direct builds (and `%UserProfile%\DeskBox\.appdata` on Microsoft Store builds so MSIX package resets never wipe your data), while new managed storage folders default to a fixed non-system drive with ample free space (such as `D:\DeskBox\`) or `%UserProfile%\DeskBox`. - **Network calls are strictly opt-in / intentional**: DeskBox only accesses the network for weather forecasts, update checks, ECDSA-verified remote widget/prompt catalog (`catalog`) updates, user-configured AI / WebDAV endpoints, enabled custom-widget network sources, confirmed remote URL imports, or explicitly submitted feedback diagnostics. - **Upgrades, privileges & safe uninstall**: Direct builds install to `Program Files\DeskBox` or unelevated per-user `%LocalAppData%\Programs\DeskBox` via Inno Setup and preserve existing scope, settings, and storage across upgrades. Launching elevated shows a clear Explorer drag-and-drop notice with a one-click normal-privilege restart. Uninstalling lets you keep or remove app data while **always preserving user files inside managed storage folders**. --- ## Build from Source Development requires **Windows 11** and **.NET SDK 10.0.404** (or a later `10.0.4xx` patch pinned in [global.json](global.json); Visual Studio with the Windows App SDK workload is recommended). Retail Native AOT builds and native Rust / QuickJS modules (`-p:DeskBoxRustNative=true`) also require the Rust toolchain pinned in [rust-toolchain.toml](rust-toolchain.toml) and Visual Studio C++ build tools (`VC.Tools.x86.x64` for `x64`, `VC.Tools.ARM64` for `ARM64`). Restore, test, and build `x64` Debug: ```powershell dotnet restore .\DeskBox.sln -p:Platform=x64 dotnet test .\tests\DeskBox.Tests\DeskBox.Tests.csproj --configuration Debug --no-restore -p:Platform=x64 -v:minimal dotnet build .\src\DeskBox\DeskBox.csproj --configuration Debug --no-restore -p:Platform=x64 -v:minimal ``` Publish retail Full Native AOT payloads via the authoritative script (compiles Rust / QuickJS native libraries, bundles private Windows App Runtime 2.7, and generates `DeskBox.InstallManifest.txt` for safe upgrades): ```powershell .\scripts\publish-aot-retail.ps1 -Platform x64 .\scripts\publish-aot-retail.ps1 -Platform ARM64 ``` Compile offline installers with **Inno Setup 6.5 or newer** (do not substitute bare `dotnet publish`, as the installer requires `DeskBox.InstallManifest.txt` to clean up retired files safely): ```powershell ISCC.exe /DDeskBoxNativeAot=1 /DDeskBoxBundledRuntime=1 /DMyAppReleaseDir=..\.artifacts\aot-retail\win-x64\publish .\installer\DeskBox.iss ISCC.exe /DDeskBoxNativeAot=1 /DDeskBoxBundledRuntime=1 /DMyAppReleaseDir=..\.artifacts\aot-retail\win-arm64\publish .\installer\DeskBox.arm64.iss ``` Expected outputs: ```text Output\DeskBox_Setup_1.6.1_x64.exe Output\DeskBox_Setup_1.6.1_arm64.exe ``` ### Project Layout ```text src\DeskBox WinUI 3 app, widget engine, Studio, companion hosts, and core services src\DeskBox.Updater Direct-channel updater helper native Rust native Shell / thumbnail proxy (deskbox-native / deskbox-thumbnail-proxy) and QuickJS sandbox (deskbox-qjs) catalog Remote custom widget catalog and AI prompt OTA rules (widgets.v1.json / prompts.v1.json) tests\DeskBox.Tests Service, contract, sandbox, and Native AOT guardrail test suite scripts AOT retail publish, native build, local dev, and catalog validation scripts installer x64 / ARM64 Inno Setup scripts and multi-language installer messages docs Architecture specs, requirements, code-signing policy, and visual assets .github\workflows CI build/test, ARM64 native gate, and distribution audit workflows ``` --- ## Feedback, Credits & Licensing - **Feedback & support**: Share bug reports or suggestions via the in-app **Feedback** entry, [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/issues), or [deskbox.fun](https://deskbox.fun); see [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md) for details. - **Special thanks**: [@magisph](https://github.com/magisph) for Brazilian Portuguese localization. - **Author**: Tianyu Zhu (朱天雨) · Repository: - **Dual Licensing**: Starting with **1.6.0**, DeskBox is dual-licensed under [GPL-3.0-only](LICENSE) and a [Commercial License](LICENSING.md) (independent `.dbxwidget` custom widgets are explicitly exempt from GPL copyleft, while DeskBox branding and official `deskbox.fun` endpoints are reserved; commercial inquiries: `1047078635@qq.com`). Earlier MIT and single-track GPL-3.0-only releases remain under their original licenses and are not changed retroactively. ## Star History If DeskBox makes your desktop cleaner and more enjoyable, a star ⭐ is a huge encouragement for this solo project. [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=Tianyu199509/DeskBox&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#Tianyu199509/DeskBox&Date)

# DeskBox **开源、本地优先的 Windows 10/11 桌面整理工具，提供原生质感的 WinUI 3 格子与自定义组件生态。** 简体中文 | [English](README.md) [下载与安装](#下载与安装) · [核心功能](#核心功能) · [界面预览](#界面与视觉体验) · [技术概览](#技术概览) · [从源码构建](#从源码构建) · [授权协议](LICENSING.md) [![CI](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Tianyu199509/DeskBox?label=release&color=2563EB)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases/latest) [![Windows 10/11](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-10%2F11-0078D4.svg)](#技术概览) [![x64 and ARM64](https://img.shields.io/badge/architecture-x64%20%7C%20ARM64-5C2D91.svg)](#下载与安装) [![License: GPL v3 | Commercial](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPLv3%20%7C%20Commercial-blue.svg)](LICENSING.md) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Tianyu199509/DeskBox?style=flat&color=yellow)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/stargazers) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/total?style=flat&color=brightgreen)](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases)
> **贡献状态说明：** 项目处于高频迭代与扩展解耦期，暂不接受外部 Pull Request 代码合并，欢迎通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/issues) 或 Discussions 提交 Bug 反馈与功能建议，详见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ![DeskBox Windows 桌面整理工具，包含文件、待办、剪贴板、天气、音乐与自定义组件](docs/images/brand/readme-hero-1-3-7-dark-zh-cn.png) DeskBox 基于 C#、WinUI 3、.NET 10 Native AOT 与 Rust 原生层构建，在原生 Windows 桌面上增加一层轻盈的桌面格子，不替换系统资源管理器，也不改变文件原有的物理存储方式。以真实文件夹为基础的文件格子使它成为 Stardock Fences 等工具的现代开源替代；同时提供剪贴板历史、全局搜索弹窗、待办与随记、时光、天气、音乐控制以及可编程的自定义桌面组件。 --- ## 下载与安装 | 分发渠道 | 适用版本与特点 | 获取地址 | | --- | --- | --- | | **GitHub Releases（官网直装版）** | `x64` / `ARM64` 离线安装包，Full Native AOT 构建，内置私有 Windows App Runtime 2.7，支持应用内静默更新与伴侣进程隔离 | [前往 GitHub Releases 最新版](https://github.com/Tianyu199509/DeskBox/releases/latest) | | **官方网站** | 查看产品介绍、下载直装安装包与使用文档 | [deskbox.fun](https://deskbox.fun) | | **Microsoft Store（商店付费版）** | 微软商店托管签名与自动更新，适合希望直接支持项目持续维护的用户 | [前往 Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/store/detail/9PBZSNB4D69H) | - **完整性校验**：GitHub Releases 每个安装包均附带同名 `.sha256` 校验文件，安装前可核对文件哈希；详情参阅[代码签名与校验策略](docs/code-signing.md)。 - **系统门槛**：支持 **Windows 10 2004（Build 19041）及以上** 与 **Windows 11（推荐 22H2+）**，原生支持 `x64` 与 `ARM64`（骁龙等 Windows on ARM 设备），支持标准系统目录安装或免提权当前用户安装，可完全离线安装。 - **版本发布记录**：完整版本演进与详细更新内容请参阅 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。 --- ## 核心功能 ### 1. 文件格子与桌面整理 - **真实文件夹映射与收纳**：创建由本地文件夹支撑的收纳格子，或直接把桌面、磁盘中的已有文件夹映射到桌面而不改变原文件位置；旧文件迁入托管存储采用“先复制、后校验、不自动删源”的稳妥流程。 - **Windows 11 原生级文件交互**：内嵌 Windows 11 样式单竖列右键菜单（含行内图标、「打开方式」真实关联应用、空白处「新建 / 查看 / 排序」与原生 ZIP 压缩/解压），支持按空格调用 [QuickLook](https://github.com/QL-Win/QuickLook) 预览。 - **多源拖拽与叠放管理**：完整支持资源管理器、微信及浏览器内容（含远程链接下载导入）拖入与拖出、手动排序、格子内子文件夹折叠弹窗（自适应 / 3×3 / 5×5），以及提权会话下的指针跟踪安全拖出。 - **全类型格子分组与桌面整理工作台**：任意类型格子均可无损合并为分组标签页（支持联通标签与等宽并列模式、`Ctrl+Tab` 与滚轮切换及亚克力合并/拆出落点预览）；桌面整理工作台支持按分类与扩展名规则预览分流、自动后台归档新落盘文件及历史操作回溯。 ### 2. 日常效率与桌面组件 - **统一全局搜索弹窗（`Alt+D`）**：通过本地 IPC 直连已安装的 Everything 索引并与桌面格子、随记、待办、剪贴板历史、应用及设置合并检索（DeskBox 不维护重复索引，Everything 需单独安装）；内置即时计算器、命令面板、网页搜索兜底与推荐区编辑模式（应用文件夹分组与多选拖拽排序）。 - **剪贴板历史与全局快捷粘贴（`Alt+V`）**：自动采集文本、HTML/RTF 富文本、图片、文件与色值，支持 `Alt+V` 全局快捷粘贴弹窗、本机离线图片 OCR 检索、内置文本快捷转换、可选网页链接标题自动抓取、来源应用排除规则、大条目外置存储，以及敏感凭据的本机 DPAPI 静态加密与脱敏显示。 - **响应式待办与随记**：支持单/双栏自适应布局、中英文自然语言日期/时间/重复规则录入、全文检索、逾期一键顺延、待办与随记双向互转、提醒与颜色标记、随记独立置顶小窗、多条笔记合并，以及关联或托管附件的 Markdown 目录镜像同步。 - **时光、天气与音乐组件**：时光格子融合日期、农历与节气；天气内置 MSN 天气与 Open-Meteo 回退及 4 套内置图标风格；音乐组件接管 Windows 系统媒体会话，提供专辑氛围色、频谱动画与 LRCLIB / 本地 `.lrc` 同步滚动歌词。 ### 3. 自定义格子与格子工坊（Widget Studio） - **零 WebView 原生声明式引擎**：基于扁平元素图（`manifest.json`）渲染原生 WinUI 3 桌面组件，彻底摆脱 WebView 常驻内存开销。 - **沙盒脚本与细粒度权限门禁**：交互式自定义组件支持内置隔离的 QuickJS 脚本沙箱（`logic.js`），受指令步数、运行耗时与内存配额硬上限保护，并提供按组件独立管控的能力权限开关（公网、局域网/本机、剪贴板与系统控制、本地文件读写、终端命令执行）。 - **三通道创作与 Agent 生态**：支持**自有 API 直连**、**外部编程智能体接入**（`--mcp` 标准输入输出桥接与 CLI Skill，无缝联动 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf 等）及**零配置网页 AI 提示词协同**；内置 14 款 13 语种官方模板、ECDSA P-256 签名远程目录与提示词热更新、`.dbxwidget` 导入导出、`deskbox://` 协议深链，以及外部变更落盘前的**原生宿主授权与暂存预览确认（stage-and-preview）**。 ### 4. 胶囊模式、原生材质与多屏记忆 - **智能胶囊与快速唤起**：任意格子可收起为桌面胶囊或组合成可拖拽胶囊栏，支持悬停展开、敏感内容隐私遮蔽；可通过托盘、`F7`、双击 `Ctrl`、`Alt+Space`、空白桌面双击或自定义全局快捷键唤起「快捷唤起层」。 - **Windows 原生材质与个性定制**：支持云母（Mica）与亚克力（Acrylic）材质、DWM 圆角、单格子自定义图标/背景图，以及跟随材质、统一图片和按桌面前后位置取景的全景背景模式。 - **按显示器拓扑的多屏记忆**：自动记忆每套外接显示器组合的布局并绑定显示器硬件身份，拔屏时自动收起或迁移、接回后逐格归位；DPI 缩放切换、睡眠唤醒与全屏游戏切分辨率均不破坏原有排版。 ### 5. 轻量 Native AOT 运行时、备份与可靠性 - **伴侣进程隔离与内存回收**：采用 `.NET 10 Full Native AOT` + `Rust` 原生 Shell 层；设置中心与格子工坊采用独立伴侣进程承载（通过鉴权命名管道通信），Shell 缩略图提取通过独立代理进程隔离，关闭窗口即刻回收界面内存，并配合分级闲置内存修剪控制常驻占用。 - **原子持久化、便携快照与云备份**：设置与布局采用可恢复事务快照落盘并支持配置意外丢失后的自动恢复引导；提供本地定时快照、跨设备便携备份导出（可选导出解密后的明文剪贴板快照，并在恢复外源包时自动剥离本机绑定密钥与权限）、按数据域独立控制的个人 WebDAV 定时备份，以及一键导出脱敏诊断包。 --- ## 界面与视觉体验 DeskBox 采用贴近 Windows 11 原生设计语言的材质与圆角体系，在保留普通桌面操作习惯的同时融入桌面背景。 | 云母材质（Mica） | 亚克力材质（Acrylic） | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox 中文界面的 Windows 11 云母材质桌面格子](docs/images/screenshots/zh-cn/云母材质.png) | ![DeskBox 中文界面的 Windows 11 亚克力材质桌面格子](docs/images/screenshots/zh-cn/亚克力材质.png) | | 格子工坊：精选模板与多通道生成 | 格子工坊：实时预览舞台与点选微调 | | --- | --- | | ![DeskBox 中文格子工坊模板画廊](docs/images/screenshots/zh-cn/studio-gallery.png) | ![DeskBox 中文格子工坊实时预览舞台与 AI 微调](docs/images/screenshots/zh-cn/studio-stage.png) |

本地优先、隐私与安装说明 - **数据完全归属本地**：无需注册账号；官网直装版的设置与格子数据保存在 `%LocalAppData%\DeskBox\data`（微软商店版保存在 `%UserProfile%\DeskBox\.appdata` 持久化目录，商店重置或重装不丢失数据），新建托管收纳文件夹优先选在空间充足的非系统固定磁盘（如 `D:\DeskBox\用户名`），否则回退到 `%UserProfile%\DeskBox`。 - **仅在必要场景联网**：仅当触发天气查询、版本更新检查、ECDSA 签名校验的远程组件/提示词目录（`catalog`）拉取、用户自行配置的 AI / WebDAV 端点、已授权开启的自定义组件网络源、主动导入网络链接或明确点击提交反馈诊断时才会发生网络通信。 - **安装、权限与卸载保护**：直装版通过 Inno Setup 支持安装到系统 `Program Files\DeskBox` 或免提权当前用户目录 `%LocalAppData%\Programs\DeskBox`，覆盖升级自动沿用既有安装范围并保留全部设置与数据；若误以管理员权限启动，应用会提示资源管理器拖拽权限限制并提供一键切换普通权限重启。卸载时可选择保留或清除应用配置数据，**用户托管文件夹中的真实个人文件永远不会被删除**。 --- ## 从源码构建 开发环境需要 **Windows 11** 与 **.NET SDK 10.0.404**（或 [global.json](global.json) 锁定的 `10.0.4xx` 后续补丁版本；推荐安装含 Windows App SDK 工作负载的 Visual Studio）。构建零售版 Native AOT 及 Rust / QuickJS 原生模块（`-p:DeskBoxRustNative=true`）还需要 [rust-toolchain.toml](rust-toolchain.toml) 锁定的 Rust 工具链以及 Visual Studio C++ 构建工具（`x64` 需 `VC.Tools.x86.x64`，`ARM64` 需 `VC.Tools.ARM64`）。 还原、运行测试并构建 `x64` Debug 版本： ```powershell dotnet restore .\DeskBox.sln -p:Platform=x64 dotnet test .\tests\DeskBox.Tests\DeskBox.Tests.csproj --configuration Debug --no-restore -p:Platform=x64 -v:minimal dotnet build .\src\DeskBox\DeskBox.csproj --configuration Debug --no-restore -p:Platform=x64 -v:minimal ``` 使用官方发布脚本打包零售版 Full Native AOT 载荷（自动编译 Rust / QuickJS 原生库、嵌入私有 Windows App Runtime 2.7 并生成升级清单 `DeskBox.InstallManifest.txt`）： ```powershell .\scripts\publish-aot-retail.ps1 -Platform x64 .\scripts\publish-aot-retail.ps1 -Platform ARM64 ``` 使用 **Inno Setup 6.5 及以上版本**编译离线安装包（请勿用裸 `dotnet publish` 代替上方脚本，否则安装器缺少 `DeskBox.InstallManifest.txt` 无法安全清理旧版本载荷）： ```powershell ISCC.exe /DDeskBoxNativeAot=1 /DDeskBoxBundledRuntime=1 /DMyAppReleaseDir=..\.artifacts\aot-retail\win-x64\publish .\installer\DeskBox.iss ISCC.exe /DDeskBoxNativeAot=1 /DDeskBoxBundledRuntime=1 /DMyAppReleaseDir=..\.artifacts\aot-retail\win-arm64\publish .\installer\DeskBox.arm64.iss ``` 预期生成安装包： ```text Output\DeskBox_Setup_1.6.1_x64.exe Output\DeskBox_Setup_1.6.1_arm64.exe ``` ### 项目结构 ```text src\DeskBox WinUI 3 主应用、桌面格子引擎、工坊、伴侣宿主与业务服务 src\DeskBox.Updater 官网直装版更新辅助程序 native Rust 原生 Shell / 缩略图代理（deskbox-native / deskbox-thumbnail-proxy）与 QuickJS 沙盒（deskbox-qjs） catalog 自定义组件远程模板与 AI 提示词目录（widgets.v1.json / prompts.v1.json） tests\DeskBox.Tests 服务、契约、沙盒与 Native AOT 守卫测试套件 scripts AOT 发布、原生构建、本地调试与目录发布校验脚本 installer x64 / ARM64 Inno Setup 安装脚本与多语言词条 docs 架构文档、需求规范、代码签名策略与品牌截图资产 .github\workflows CI 构建测试、ARM64 原生门禁与分发审计工作流 ``` --- ##
